reason: I don't even know whose brand this is. We only buy what we see on TV, like LG or Samsung, and right now every rupee is going toward the wedding, so I'm not spending ₹22,000 on a name nobody in the village has tried.
objection: If the battery or motor fails after two years, will this company still be around and will the dealer get spare parts? Also, will a cold wash really get muddy farm clothes clean?
would_change_my_mind: If a big brand I know from TV sold it, or a neighbour had used one through a whole monsoon season with no trouble, and the EMI came down to around ₹1,200 a month.
